name: What are the common signs that my pool heater gas line needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs that my pool heater gas line needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your pool heater gas line may need repair include a persistent sulfur or rotten egg smell near the heater, a noticeable drop in water pressure to the heater, or inconsistent heating performance. Visible corrosion on the gas line or pilot light issues can also indicate a problem. It's crucial to address these signs promptly to ensure safety and efficient operation. CG Plumbing Solutions offers inspections to diagnose these issues accurately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include sulfur smell, low water pressure to the heater, inconsistent heating, or visible corrosion.
